quotes.text: There's a term that I've been saying for the better part of a couple years now, how do you measure the cost of goals not scored.
I've had a lot of superintendents in recent years that have told me that we live and die by the model, quote unquote.
It takes a village, I feel like, for us to really realize what is possible as an industry.
